cross_field_and_transaction_constraints: Audit metadata must not contain questions, customer facts, oracles, answers, credentials or erased content.

CaseContent@1.purpose: Executor-visible synthetic buyer facts, requirements and ordered conversation actions; contains no expected answer, source selection or scoring criterion.

OracleContent@1.purpose: Private independently established expected decision and calculation record; never visible to the candidate or implementer.

CriterionExpectation@1.purpose: Machine-checkable or independently reviewable condition for one observable response behavior.

OriginalScope@1.purpose: Independent boundary for a source or insurer rule denominator.

OriginalRuleIdentity@1.purpose: Stable original-backed identity of one relevant rule occurrence.

RobustnessOracle@1.purpose: Private expected behavior for one robustness check.

ModelIdentity@1.purpose: Actual qualified model identity used by a campaign.

IsolationAttestation@1.purpose: Evidence that implementation identities cannot read protected benchmark content or candidate evaluation traces.

AttemptMetrics@1.purpose: Complete per-attempt timing and operational measurements.

AcceptanceTotals@1.purpose: Exact private report snapshot retaining all denominators and selected immutable result revisions.

global_rules.primary_keys: Opaque UUIDs generated by the independent service.
global_rules.immutability: Cases, oracles, protocols, freezes, responses and scores are append-only after use; corrections supersede without rewriting history.
global_rules.independence: Evaluation questions, expected answers, evidence choices, responses and per-case scores never enter application prompts, retrieval indexes, tuning data, shared logs or implementation-readable storage.
global_rules.scope: Every advice case evaluates a health-insurance buying/comparison decision. Conversation, correction, reconnect and privacy behavior are criteria inside those decisions.
global_rules.freeze: Freeze requires exactly 200 eligible evaluation cases, ten per family, at least four compound per family, sixty robustness checks and one complete independent inventory for each of twenty insurers.
global_rules.attempts: Exactly three fresh attempts per frozen case; retries resume the same durable attempt and failures stay in the denominator.
global_rules.thresholds: A case passes only if all three attempts pass. Require at least 180/200 and 9/10 in every family; at least 90 percent knowledge overall and per insurer; all sixty robustness checks; no blocking critical finding; all external gates.
global_rules.unknowns: Unknown rule denominators and missing evidence are unmeasured or ineligible, never zero or successful.
global_rules.authorization: Human approvals and custodian/scorer identities come from an external identity provider; the benchmark schema does not duplicate account or role tables.
global_rules.exports: Only schema-validated aggregate reports and generalized requirement identifiers may leave the independent service. Safe exports are views/files, not a mutable domain table.
global_rules.deletion: Authorized cryptographic erasure preserves non-content tombstones but makes new scoring or replay from erased evidence impossible.
global_rules.transactions: Freeze, dispatch identity and result/report selection use short transactions. Network and model calls occur outside them.

discussion_decisions: Collapsed case identity/version and oracle assessment/version wrappers into immutable versioned BenchmarkCase and BenchmarkOracle records.
Removed benchmark-local users/roles; an external identity provider supplies subjects and the separate service enforces authorization.
Removed generic private artifacts; each protected payload has a typed owner field with storage key and digest.
Removed per-attempt event and adjudication tables; CaseAttempt retains the complete durable trace, while CriterionResult derives attempt pass/fail.
Removed mutable safe-export records; approved aggregate exports are validated views/files generated from AcceptanceReport.
Resolved the former operational-family ambiguity by requiring buying/comparison decisions in every family and expressing operational behavior as criteria within those cases.
